North Carolina is mortgaged, so acquiring it means either paying 10% interest or unmortgaging for $165. That'd give me two of three greens, but p3 still holds Pennsylvania so it's not a monopoly — and spending $275 on a mortgaged property essentially bankrolls p4's Boardwalk houses, which seems like a bad trade.

A better angle is yellow: I already own Ventnor, Atlantic is unowned, and p4 has Marvin Gardens. Proposing a counter to acquire Marvin Gardens — maybe for $200 cash since p4 seems cash-poor — could set up a yellow monopoly once Atlantic gets bought or auctioned. I'll counter with Marvin Gardens for $200.
